scope: BTC only, offline research. Defaults unchanged; diagnostic attribution is not a financed wallet or prospective alpha.

earned-profit-giveback.rule: Confirmed actual filled long ownership; R=actual fill entry minus initial installed accepted stop. After two completed owned days, completed-close peak-entry>=R and latest completed close remains>=entry while giving back>=half peak-entry. First original lawful HOLD decision only; reduce half owned quantity, then full-exit expression if half lacks useful benefit. No stop inferred from ATR or later protective request.
earned-profit-giveback.control: Unconditional first lawful HOLD after two completed owned days, same half/full exit expression. Recorded retained settlement and subsequent completed lows are attribution only; no reinvestment, funding extrapolation or scaled curve.
earned-profit-giveback.failure: Missing causal accepted installed-stop receipt => BLOCKED_INPUT, retain pure proposal. Actual zero intervention => SUPPORT_PENDING. Both expressions economically fail => close this mechanism, use independent information.

campaign-debt.rule: Only fully settled actual filled cohort/campaign with cost-net cash P&L, including all BTC/USDT fees and actual perpetual income. First negative settlement halves subsequent original NEW BUY/new campaign; fixed alternative blocks after two consecutive negative settlements. Prior profitable/nonnegative fully settled campaign ends consecutive-loss streak; new completed close strictly above remembered losing-campaign owned-close peak also resets it. No consumed-identity retry, held topup, unfilled request, censored residual or hypothetical outcome enters memory.
campaign-debt.control: Fixed half of all actual new filled baskets, reported side-by-side in each era. Attribution never asserts equality of exposure or a counterfactual financed wallet.
campaign-debt.failure: First expression fails => evaluate fixed two-loss expression using same immutable receipts. Both fail => change information/mechanism, no parameter grid.

screen_admission.alpha: Positive avoided cost-net cash in both eras and better than fixed half-entry attribution in both eras; sufficient distinct settled cohorts. This admits actual wallet measurement only.
screen_admission.risk: For giveback, positive removed subsequent downside in both eras and foregone cash / removed downside <=0.50, better benefit/cost ratio than unconditional timing control in both eras. Lower wealth alone is not an automatic veto.
screen_admission.uncertainty: Completed daily close/low opportunity diagnostics omit partial bars and financing path; no continuous MDD, beta, alpha regression or account qualification claim.
screen_admission.negative_results: Preserve all policies and controls, including no action and failed-input cases. Thresholds fixed before outcomes.
screen_admission.exit_quote: A uses last causally available completed daily close as a hypothetical exitquote, fee .001 and slippage .0005; compare actual future owned settlements. Full subsequent UTC daily lows only; partial days omitted. Existing debt result source/spec preserved before this declaration.

account_selection: Only supported genuinely changed decisions. Earliest quarter containing admitted actual event per era, chosen by event time not profit. Independent cold wallets, original schedule, real funds/fees/protection. Root decides finite budget before execution; no automatic795.
verification: Necessary ownership/causality checks only. Root final full suites once. No network, native account actions, source-vault scan or publication in this screen.
